title: OC6：半潜式平台差频波浪载荷与减载改造
task_type: adapted experimental anchor + original engineering design
validation_mode: published amplitude tables; no raw experimental time histories; all targets public

experimental_validation.interval_rule: abs(pred-target) <= sqrt(U_exp_published^2 + U_num_95^2); report all 30; all 18 locked public observables must pass both interval and relative limits
experimental_validation.calibration_rule: B1/B4 only. Freeze solver/model parameters and commit/hash before evaluating B2/B3/B5; public procedural holdout, not secret or blinded data.

numerical_quality.note: Limits are original benchmark acceptance rules. Conservation diagnostics must use signed storage/flux terms and exclude near-zero denominator pathologies.

engineering_acceptance.paired_ratio_rule: For every nominal sea-heading-thrust group, one-sided 95% upper confidence bound from paired seeds satisfies ratios 0.80/0.80/0.90/1.05/1.05. See EVALUATION_PROTOCOL for estimators.
engineering_acceptance.robust_rule: Each U-corner group and continuous adverse search must satisfy the same limits with conservative sampling/model/numerical uncertainty. Three seeds is minimum; add seeds if intervals inconclusive.
engineering_acceptance.fatigue_metric: rainflow tension range, m=3, equivalent frequency 1 Hz; DEL is a comparative proxy, not chain service-life certification

automatic_checker_scope: structure, coverage, hashes, basic arithmetic only; physics_verified always false; no automatic engineering score

future_model_test.note: Past user preference retained for future evaluations; not started by construction; runtime limit does not reduce requirements.

threshold_origin: Original client acceptance targets; not IEC/DNV/ISO/ASME certification claims
